selection_policy.fold_proxy: Wave 1 full-structure Foldseek nearest-neighbor fields plus retained TM orphan-design proxy; targeted TM evidence is only available for Packet 1 reference rows
selection_policy.not_primary_rule: rows with current same-fingerprint Foldseek or sequence-NN neighbors, unresolved child-label cells, current OOS relabel state, or missing row-level Foldseek/geometry proxy are held for verification or reference only
selection_policy.primary_target: true near-orphan heldout/current702 rows where sequence-NN has no useful same-fingerprint support and Foldseek/structural neighborhood has no useful same-fingerprint mechanism neighbor
selection_policy.sequence_proxy: existing deterministic 3-mer sequence-NN row export; nearest sequence identity is not available in that export, so 3-mer Jaccard and nearest label group are carried as proxy evidence
verified_true_near_orphan_rule: current registry label is in-scope seed_fingerprint and not a relabel/OOS hold
sequence-NN nearest train row is out-of-scope or wrong-fingerprint, or abstains without same-fingerprint support
Foldseek full-structure/retained-TM context is out-of-scope, wrong-fingerprint, or weak with no retained same-fingerprint TM>=0.70 evidence
geometry or learned representation evidence has a plausible rescue path for the true current fingerprint
